items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: My sister Edna, well, she was a school teacher.

ctx.x: Well, what type of piano did your mother play? Was it classical or any popular music or what kind of...

Well, as I understood, she played for a while and then she gave it up. She played classical, mostly just classical, you know, out of the... You know, methodical. Method books, yes. My sister Stella, she played out of the Method books. My sister Edna, well, she was a school teacher. She would play out of the Method books. She would play all her little school songs and everything for the children, you know. But, uh, the best musician in the family would be my sister Marie, who, yes. You have to give it to her…
